name: Physitrack PLC
summary: Physitrack PLC operates globally as a digital healthcare innovator. The company delivers a proprietary cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform, utilized by a diverse range of healthcare providers, from individual practitioners to large organizations, to completely digitalize the patient journey—from their initial contact through ongoing interactions and tracking of progress. Additionally, Physitrack offers virtual care solutions that address three key areas for patients and insurance plan members: preventive and wellness support, care for acute and chronic conditions, and surgical recovery. These virtual care services are supplied to healthcare enterprises such as private and public hospitals, clinics, and other health businesses. Founded in 2012, the company was formerly known as Physitrack Limited before rebranding to Physitrack PLC in May 2021 and is based in London, United Kingdom.
